quote: Experimental results obtained by Legendre and Hancheng [60] show that the Au-Sb-Si ternary system contains two invariant reactions: a transition reaction (U) at 730 K, L + rhombohedral A7(Sb) ↔ diamond A4(Si) + AuSb2 and a eutectic reaction (E) at 605 K, L ↔ fcc A1(Au) + diamond A4(Si) + AuSb2 .
